notes: Pollinator-mediated selection is positive on flowering start in the presence of herbivory.
Pollinator-mediated selection remains positive when herbivores are excluded.
Herbivore-mediated selection is negative on flowering start under open pollination.
Herbivore-mediated selection remains negative after supplemental hand pollination.
Pollinator-mediated selection is positive on spur length in the presence of herbivory.
Pollinator-mediated selection remains positive when herbivores are excluded.
Herbivore-mediated selection is also positive on spur length under open pollination.
Herbivore-mediated selection remains positive after supplemental hand pollination.
